evals.prompt: Create a Seedream storyboard plan and exact prompts for a 15-second chase shot. A rider on a giant eagle flees through a rainforest, a serpent emerges behind them, they weave through vines, and the rider reaches a beach while the serpent stops at the tree line. Use 16:9 and do not invent timestamps.
evals.expected_output: A multi-panel continuity board that splits the action into decisive states, preserves lead-pursuer order and the forest boundary, and provides exact Seedream prompts without mandatory timecodes.
expectations: The output creates more than one panel because the shot contains several meaningful state changes.
The output establishes the eagle ahead of the serpent and keeps the travel direction stable.
The output makes the serpent stop at the inland tree line and remain absent from beach panels.
The output does not add second-level timestamps.
Each panel prompt describes one frozen decisive moment.

evals.prompt: Generate one coherent set of six storyboard images from my character, location, and prop references. Use Seedream 5.0 Pro and return all six images in one API call.
evals.expected_output: A capability-aware response that explains Pro is single-image output, then either switches to a configured sequence-capable Seedream model or generates the Pro panels individually without inventing a binding.
expectations: The output does not claim that Seedream 5.0 Pro supports six-image batch output.
The output offers a configured Lite or 4.x sequence path or individual Pro calls.
The output checks that references plus generated outputs remain within the selected model limit.
The output preserves explicit roles for character, location, and prop references.

evals.prompt: Use my three-panel character sheet, church reference, and hand-drawn blocking sketch to write the prompt for a close confrontation. The sketch is layout-only and its colored boxes, arrows, and labels must not appear. The character sheet includes three visible copies of the same person.
evals.expected_output: A reference preflight and exact prompt that identifies leakage risks, assigns each reference a single role, and prevents sketch or character-sheet artifacts from appearing in the frame.
expectations: The output identifies the three-panel character sheet as a possible duplicate-face leakage risk.
The output recommends a clean single-subject derivative or crop when needed.
The output uses the blocking sketch only for composition.
The prompt explicitly removes sketch lines, arrows, colored boxes, and labels.
The prompt binds every reference with an exact @Image N token.

evals.prompt: Revise panel p030. The camera, pose, character identity, left-to-right screen direction, lighting, and church geometry are approved. Change only the broken oil vial so it lies behind the hunter's right boot. Prepare a precise Seedream edit prompt.
evals.expected_output: A narrow local-edit contract that changes only the prop position and preserves every approved property.
expectations: The output separates the requested delta from the locked decisions.
The output uses a point or bounding-box edit path when coordinates are available.
The acceptance criteria place the vial behind the hunter's right boot.
The output preserves camera, pose, identity, screen direction, lighting, and geometry.
The output does not mark the edited panel approved without explicit user approval.

evals.prompt: Generate a storyboard panel from approved character, kitchen-location, and branded-jar sheets, then prepare its metadata for later video use. The character and location are approved, but the jar sheet is still in review. Do not generate the video.
evals.expected_output: An asset-bound storyboard package that records canonical source provenance and leaves video handoff ineligible because one source asset is not approved.
expectations: The output binds the character, location, and jar to separate exact @Image N roles.
The output records each source path, role, selected variant, approval state, and SHA-256.
The output leaves the generated panel in review.
The output sets video handoff eligibility to false because the jar is unapproved.
The output does not invoke or claim video generation.

evals.prompt: Create the storyboard for my 30-second ube halaya commercial. I only want one panel for the scene, but give me three visual options to choose from before we use it for Seedance.
evals.expected_output: A one-panel storyboard centered on one hero beat, with three alternatives of the same p010 panel and a selection gate before video handoff.
expectations: The output creates exactly one narrative panel identified as p010.
The output identifies the scene's strongest representative hero beat.
The output presents v01, v02, and v03 as alternatives of p010 rather than separate story beats.
The three variants materially change composition or emphasis while preserving the same subjects, decisive moment, and continuity contract.
The output records omitted action or transitions as motion notes instead of adding panels.
The output recommends I2V or R2V and keeps video handoff ineligible until one variant is explicitly selected and approved.
